subject: Tenant syndication connector - co-sell & marketplace syndication proposal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant syndication connector - co-sell & marketplace syndication proposal

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — good alignment on the business case. I'm looping in Ben (partners) and Vivek (alliances) so we have the right owners on the table.

Quick recap and asks so we have a shared starting point:
- Goal: build a marketplace connector that lets DataForge push tenant-level listings (tenant syndication) for customers that want co-sell on AWS/Azure/GCP while preserving tenant isolation, billing attribution, and marketplace metering.
- Scope questions: who owns the listing entity, what evidence is required for co-sell certification (security, telemetry), and how billing/metering will be reconciled between our systems.

Could you share a short architecture diagram (high level), your expected on-boarding steps for an ISV listing, and any constraints on the data flow (e.g., PII, encryption at rest requirements)? I've attached a one-page scope outline to frame the discussion (syndication-scope-outline.pdf).

Tentative next step from our side: 90-minute technical + GTM workshop (internal + your engineering/product + marketplace partner ops) the week of Jan 10 — does that window work for you?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sara Lin <sara@dataforge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 13:22:43 -0500
Subject: Re: Tenant syndication connector - co-sell & marketplace syndication proposal

Connor — thanks, really helpful summary. We're excited about this. High-level answers and next steps from DataForge: 

1) Architecture and ownership
- Our proposed model is a hybrid listing: DataForge will operate the connector as a managed service but the listing metadata (tenant affiliation and billing mapping) will be provided by Redwood. This allows us to co-sell while keeping purchase attribution correct.
- Data flow: minimal tenant metadata and non-PII usage metrics are pushed to marketplaces; sensitive customer content is never routed through the marketplace listing. We'll provide a diagram in the follow-up doc.

2) On-boarding and certification
- Typical steps: (a) security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence, (b) integration test with marketplace metering API, (c) listing review & co-sell enablement with partner sales. Expect 4–6 weeks if evidence is ready.

3) Metering and billing
- We support both marketplace metered billing and invoice reconciliation. Need to align on unit economics and the metering events mapping (tokens, inference-second, embedding-unit).

We've attached a short proposal and an initial connector spec (dataforge-marketplace-connector-proposal-v1.docx).

Workshop: Jan 12 (US/PST) works for our engineering leads — propose Jan 12 at 10:00 PT for a 90-minute session. Will your legal team be able to review a short MOU prior to the workshop?

PRIORITY: can you point us to Redwood's SOC2 report and your preferred evidence handoff format?

Best,
Sara Lin
Head of Partnerships | DataForge Labs
sara@dataforge.com | +1 617-555-0210

Attachment: dataforge-marketplace-connector-proposal-v1.docx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Tenant syndication connector - internal evidence & cadence

Connor / team — quick internal notes after reading Sara's reply:

- Evidence we should be prepared to share: SOC2 Type II (latest), architecture diagram with network boundaries, encryption/KMS details, data retention policy, and a telemetry sample for metering (token counts per request).
- Operational asks: SLA targets for the connector (uptime, incident response), escalation path, and sample onboarding checklist for a pilot customer.
- Billing: need to confirm whether we will (A) surface usage to marketplace for metered billing or (B) report usage to DataForge and let them reconcile. Recommendation: prefer (A) for clarity in co-sell but be flexible.

I'm attaching the evidence checklist we usually hand to partners (marketplace-evidence-checklist.xlsx). Olga, can you flag anything else legal/compliance will need? Vivek — want to align on co-sell play (who owns post-deal SDR/AE coverage).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
